name: Bassethound
description:
Bassethound is company intelligence for AI agents. Point it at any domain and get back one correlated, source-linked dossier of what a company runs, how AI-ready it is, and whether it fits - over MCP, with no API key and zero setup.

A single `sniff_domain` call returns five correlated layers:

- Tech stack - frameworks, CMS, analytics, payments, and the widgets a site loads.
- Infrastructure - DNS, TLS, hosting, CDN, and email posture (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), plus a DNS-verified vendor graph.
- Firmographics - company details, description, contacts, and social profiles.
- AI-readiness - deep backend AI-stack fingerprinting: llms.txt, live MCP endpoints (handshake-confirmed), model providers, vector stores, LLM SDKs, and AI-crawler policy; evidence of whether a company is shipping, experimenting, or ignoring AI.
- Security - HTTP header and TLS posture at a glance.

Most tools give you one layer and leave you to stitch the rest together. Bassethound fuses all five in a single response, correlated and source-linked, so an agent can reason over a whole company from one call. Results render as an interactive in-chat report, and as plain JSON for any other client.

Getting started is one browser sign-in, no API key and no credit card. The free tier starts the moment you authorize.

It reads only public information - the target's own pages, DNS, TLS certificates, and well-known files - never authenticated or private data, and never anything from your Claude account. 

External detection sees what is publicly observable, so a quiet result means nothing surfaced, not that nothing is there. Bassethound reports the gap rather than guessing.

Built for sales research, lead qualification, competitive teardown, security posture checks, and ICP scoring. Powered by NimbleBrain.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Bassethound to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Bassethound to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.bassethound.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Bassethound MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bassethound provides these MCP tools: manage_account, sniff_domain, and upgrade.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Bassethound?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Bassethound in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Bassethound requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Bassethound is developed by NimbleBrain, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
